title: Witkoff and Kushner Meet Putin, Then Brief Zelensky in Dublin
detail: On Nov 12 US envoys Witkoff and Kushner left the Kremlin after talks with Putin and said a new round of talks had been agreed, with no dates or venue given. Putin proposed a temporary 'humanitarian mission' in Kostiantynivka, with demining, and Witkoff said Putin agreed to let Europeans join the next round, which the Kremlin then played down. That evening Zelensky met the envoys at Casement Aerodrome near Dublin, with Umerov present, and said they described the coming prisoner exchange as the biggest of the war.

media.caption: Zelensky meets Trump's envoys in Dublin after their summit with Putin
